title: Base Write Multiple Registers variant 4
purpose: Cover a distinct write family with a complete FC10 request carrying multiple register values and an exception-shaped response alternative for response parser diversity.
expected_behavior: A conforming peer would typically either acknowledge the starting address and quantity on success or return an exception-shaped response using the same transaction context if the request is not accepted.
constraints_preserved: 7-byte MBAP header used in both messages
Request MBAP length 000d matches unit identifier plus 12-byte PDU
Function code 10 matches the named Write Multiple Registers operation in the request
Quantity 0003 and byte count 06 agree with three 16-bit register values
Exception response MBAP length 0003 matches unit identifier plus 2-byte exception PDU
Transaction identifier is consistent across request and response
issue_safety_notes: Model-prior conservative seed only. Exception-shaped coverage is included for parser diversity and should not be interpreted as a vulnerability claim or externally verified behavior.
